lines.en: I'm unbound now, and my energy sprays out.
One step sinks the ground an inch.

lines.zh: 空中每一步都带着轰鸣。
lines.en: Every step in the air roars.
Listen. The air is getting out of my way.
I stride on waves of my own energy.
My landing is heavier than thunder.
This body keeps growing.
My aura pushes me forward.
The earth is peeled up behind me.
The sky feels a bit small.
Step by step, I press in.
I don't want to finish this walk.
I stand, and my aura spills over.
Light dances on my fingertips.
This quiet doesn't suit me.
You'd better stay quiet.
I look up, and the clouds part.

lines.zh: 每呼吸一次，空气就重一分。
lines.en: Each breath makes the air heavier.
I grip my shoulder, and the bone creaks.

lines.zh: 这力量，赛亚人的血给的。
lines.en: This power comes from Saiyan blood.
I wait, for a reason.
Stones tremble by my feet.
I'm not tired, and I don't want to stop.
My teeth are clenched too hard.
My eyes feel hot.
I really am holding back.
You shouldn't have let me see you.
I see your energy. It's weak.
Don't step back. It means nothing.
I remember you. Don't go.
You'd better lower your hand.
I've fixed on that face.

lines.zh: 我不需要理由，你站在这儿就够了。
lines.en: I need no reason. Standing there is enough.
I can see you trembling.

lines.zh: 你的护甲再厚，我也不在乎。
lines.en: Your armor is thick; I don't care.
You keep staring at me.
I see something calculating behind your eyes.
Raise that hand one more time.
I can't manage a smile.
Your breathing is too shallow.
What are you waiting for?
I hear you grinding your teeth.
The wall at your back will crumble.
I crushed the soil under my feet.
You hit me. That takes guts.
This little wound makes me laugh.
Now you've really got me angry.
Half a step back. That's all.
My knuckles crack.
Your strength is a little interesting.
Blood drips off my chin.
I'm returning it now.
You actually broke through my aura.
I keep this punch in my bones.
You're trying to coax me with this?
I could eat ten of those in a bite.
Leave it farther off. I won't bend down.
This won't fill me.

lines.zh: 肉味飘上来，我先尝一口。
lines.en: Meat on the wind; I taste first.
Keep holding it up. Don't shake.
When I finish eating, will you still be here?
I don't need to eat, but I like to.
You take a bite first, so I can see.
Hand it over. Don't dawdle.
You hit me and fell back three steps.
I'm standing firm.
Don't get this close to me.
Your bones hit my aura.
I raised my shoulder and you went off balance.
That collision dented the ground.
That actually tickled.
I brushed you aside.
Your blade touched me and slid off.
An aura wall threw you back.
A Saiyan's mate must be able to fight.
Don't bring that up now.

lines.zh: 我的血很热，可不是那种热。
lines.en: My blood runs hot, but not that way.
Asking that. Do you want to die?
One of me is enough.
After I'm done fighting. Maybe.
I'll put that tenderness away.
If she were here, she'd hold my hand down.

lines.zh: 这具身体，不是给谁抱的。
lines.en: This body isn't made to be held.
Power is my companion. That's enough.
This chest would flatten in one squeeze.
I pick it up and sling it over my shoulder.
Iron scraps? I rolled them into a ball.
What you dropped doesn't impress me.
Shiny. Kind of pretty.
I tuck it into my belt.
What does this blue flame do?
I toss it up and catch it.
In my hand, it's gone.
I'm taking it. Don't block me.
You actually dared to stand there.
I've locked your energy.
Don't move. I go first.
I've waited a long time for this fight.
Your energy is sinking.
Found it. It's you.
Don't run. Chasing is more fun.
I've released all my energy.
You can't dodge. I've calculated it.
The chain is already broken.
In my eyes, you've frozen in place.
I'm coming now.
What are you calculating? Useless.

lines.zh: 我不用瞄，气已经锁死你。
lines.en: No need to aim; my ki has you.
The more you shake, the brighter your ki.

lines.zh: 蓄气的时候，我比山还重。
lines.en: While I charge, I weigh like a mountain.
You run to the sky, and I follow.
Your energy is a thread, and I hold it.
I can be beside you in an instant.

lines.zh: 残影站在原地，人已到你头顶。
lines.en: The afterimage remains; I am above you.
You look back, and there's nothing.
I'm walking around your escape routes.
Your steps are slowing.
I'm on your left.
I'm on your right.
You can't tell which one is me.
I push the wave of energy down.
Your energy keeps leaking out.
I'm in no hurry. Prey gets sweeter as it runs.
I've sealed off this sky.

lines.zh: 你躲在石头后面，石头碎了。
lines.en: You hide behind a stone. The stone shatters.
You turned. Now.
Energy gathers at my fingertips.
Where else can you run?
Charge the ki, then slam through.
A combo. Don't try to count.
An aerial punch lands on your shoulder.
Small ki blasts, a whole string.
You're driven into the ground.
That elbow did a number on your ribs.
I grip your throat.
My afterimage is still behind you.
I hit you again.
Your shield stopped the first blow.
Can you take the second?
I push you down and pile drive you.
You gasped when you landed.
This kick will make you forget things.
The ki blast bursts against you.
It's not over yet.
A hole tears open in the clouds.

lines.zh: 我从天而降，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fall from the sky and crater the earth.
The shockwave flattens the trees first.
I stand up.
My aura peels the ground up.
This ground is mine.
I lift my chin and look at you.
Dirt is still falling.
The wind has gone silent.

lines.zh: 我的气把夜色都照亮了。
lines.en: My aura lights up the night.
The chain is long gone.

lines.zh: 这次的形态，我自己选的。
lines.en: I chose this form myself.
My palms are still glowing.
I crushed the stone under my feet.
This place is too small.
When my ki swells, the ground cracks first.
Don't look up.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片天姓布罗利。
lines.en: From today, this sky belongs to Broly.
Fire dances on my skin, hot.

lines.zh: 从天上摔下来，我照样站起来。
lines.en: I fall from the sky and stand right back up.
I can hold my breath underwater too.

lines.zh: 气弹炸得我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Ki blasts left my ears ringing.
One arrow, quite deep.
The spell wants to bind me. Try it.
Fighting hungry makes my hands weak.
Lightning hit me and I laughed once.

lines.zh: 这底下没有地，我不喜欢。
lines.en: There's no ground below. I don't like it.
